api_role.description: The API role assigned to the integration user.

client_name.description: The name of your organization as registered with Zuora Revenue.

environment.description: Zuora Sandbox Environment. This accepts either of the two values Sandbox or Central Sandbox based on your subscription. The default environment is Sandbox.

host_name.description: The domain or URL of your Zuora Revenue instance.

is_multi_entity_feature_enabled.description: Set to `true` if there are multiple entities in your Zuora account and you only want to use one entity. Otherwise, set to `false`.

password.description: The corresponding password for the API user.

sync_mode.description: Select `Zuora Billing` to sync exclusively Zuora Billing related records. Choose `Zuora Revenue` for syncing only Zuora Revenue reports. If both Zuora Billing records and Zuora Revenue reports are to be synced, opt for `Both`.

username.description: The API username with the necessary access permissions.
